topic: Data storage limitations and TTL management
summary_markdown:
The session discussed issues with data retention and file system capacity. Specifically, the current Time To Live (TTL) mechanism is not functioning reliably, leading to excessive storage usage in the `/data/cold` directory. Due to limited space, storing all raw seen data (`raw_seen`) is deemed unsustainable.

It was decided that connecting a third level of S3 storage is necessary to manage the growing volume of data.
decisions: Implement a third-level S3 connection for data management.
action_items: Find a command to force TTL functionality in the system.
